get_fused_adam_class: get the best available FusedAdam optimizer class by trying deprecated then newer apex interfaces
create_FusedAdamV1_optimizer: create a FusedAdamV1 optimizer with custom learning rate betas and weight decay for GPU training
run_FusedAdamV1_step: run a single optimization step on FusedAdamV1 with optional gradient clipping and loss scaling
create_FusedAdamV2_optimizer: create a FusedAdamV2 optimizer that extends apex FusedAdam with multi tensor apply support
run_FusedAdamV2_step: run a single optimization step on FusedAdamV2 using multi tensor applier for fp16 and fp32 params
